name: Botox — forehead & frown lines
description: Neuromodulator that relaxes overactive muscles causing dynamic wrinkles. Ideal for horizontal forehead lines and glabellar '11' lines. Results appear in 3–7 days, last 3–4 months.

name: Botox — crow's feet
description: Targeted botulinum toxin around the lateral orbital area to soften smile lines. Complements upper face treatment for a refreshed, wide-eyed result.

name: Botox — jaw slimming (masseter)
description: Relaxes the masseter muscle to slim the lower face and address teeth grinding. Results visible in 4–6 weeks, last 4–6 months. Repeated treatment leads to longer-lasting muscle reduction.

name: Hyaluronic acid filler — lips
description: HA filler to add volume, definition or hydration to lips. Customisable from subtle enhancement to fuller result. Results last 6–12 months depending on product used.

name: Hyaluronic acid filler — cheeks
description: Deep cheek augmentation or restoration of volume loss. Lifts the midface, improves nasolabial folds indirectly. Lasts 12–18 months.

name: Hyaluronic acid filler — tear trough
description: Addresses hollow under-eye area causing dark shadows and tired appearance. Requires precise cannula technique. Results last 12–18 months.

name: Hyaluronic acid filler — nose (non-surgical rhinoplasty)
description: Reshapes and refines the nose bridge, tip, or dorsal hump without surgery. Immediate results lasting 9–12 months. Requires an experienced injector.

name: Sculptra — face volumisation
description: Poly-L-lactic acid biostimulator that gradually triggers collagen production over 2–3 months. Addresses volume loss, skin laxity, and hollow temples. Results last 2+ years. Typically 2–3 sessions recommended.

name: HIFU — full face & neck lift
description: High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound targets the SMAS layer and dermis to stimulate collagen. Lifts brows, jowls, and tightens neck. Results develop over 3 months, last 12–18 months.

name: HIFU — body contouring
description: Body HIFU for fat reduction and skin tightening in localised areas such as abdomen and thighs. Suitable post-weight loss or for stubborn pockets. 1–3 sessions recommended.

name: Profhilo — face bioremodelling
description: Ultra-pure HA injectable that spreads through tissue to deeply hydrate and stimulate collagen and elastin. Improves skin quality, laxity, and radiance. 2 sessions 4 weeks apart; results last 6 months.

name: Skin booster (Juvederm Volite / Restylane)
description: Microinjections of thin HA to deeply hydrate skin and improve elasticity and fine lines. Ideal for dry, dull, or crepe-textured skin. Series of 3 sessions recommended.

name: PRP facial (platelet-rich plasma)
description: Patient's own platelet-rich plasma injected or microneedled into skin. Stimulates natural collagen, improves texture, tone, and mild laxity. Natural regenerative approach with no foreign material.

name: Thermage FLX — face
description: Monopolar radiofrequency that heats deep dermis to tighten existing collagen and stimulate new formation. Single-session protocol with results lasting 1–2 years. Excellent for periorbital area and jowl laxity.

name: Carbon laser peel (Hollywood peel)
description: Carbon lotion applied to skin then vaporised by laser, exfoliating dead cells, unclogging pores, and reducing oil production. Brightens skin tone and improves texture in a single session.

name: Fractional CO2 laser resurfacing
description: Ablative fractional laser for significant skin resurfacing. Targets acne scars, deep wrinkles, uneven texture, and pigmentation. Results are dramatic; requires proper pre- and post-care. 1–3 sessions.

name: Microneedling with radiofrequency (Morpheus8 / Secret RF)
description: Combines microneedling with RF energy to remodel collagen in deeper skin layers. Treats acne scars, enlarged pores, skin laxity, and stretch marks. 3 sessions typically recommended.

name: IV glutathione drip
description: Intravenous glutathione for skin brightening, antioxidant support, and pigmentation reduction. Results are cumulative; typically a course of 8–10 sessions recommended for visible brightening.
